path.description: Path to the directory containing tasks

dir.description: Dir to execute the task in

precondition.description: Precondition to cancel the execution of a task and its dependencies

hidden.description: Don't show in the completion list

credentials.description: Named 1Password secrets holding archive passwords, keyed by the name accepted by --cred

proxyUrl.description: ProxyURL to use for the kubeconfig

proxy.description: Named SSH proxy for az login (tenant-level commands)

resourceGroup.description: Resource group of the key vault

scopes.description: Required OAuth scopes per gh hostname.

type.description: Access mode passed to `cloudflared access`, e.g. tcp or ssh

hostname.description: Hostname of the Cloudflare Access target to tunnel to

port.description: Local port the tunnel listens on, bound to 127.0.0.1

path.description: Path used as HOME for every cloudflared call, keeping its credentials per project

access.description: Access configurations, keyed by the name given to `access connect`

name.description:
Cluster ID or name passed to doctl. The README's sample uses the cluster
UUID, which is also what the generated kubeconfig's credential plugin
requires. The kubeconfig filename comes from the map key instead, unless
`CommandWithClusterNameFn` overrides it.

configPath.description:
Path to the doctl config file holding the API token, relative to the project
root. Exported as `DIGITALOCEAN_CONFIG` at shell startup, so every doctl
invocation in the session reads this file rather than the user's own; written
by `auth init`.

clusters.description:
Clusters addressable by this command, keyed by the name accepted as the
`cluster` argument. The key is a local alias; `name` holds the value passed
to doctl.

name.description:
Cluster name, matched against both the `cluster` argument and the kubectl
cluster whose kubeconfig is used to reach the pod.

podName.description:
Name of the etcd pod to exec into. Must be an exact pod name, not a
deployment or label selector.

namespace.description: Namespace the etcd pod runs in.

paths.description:
etcd keys offered as completions for the `path` argument. Advisory only — any
key can be typed, whether listed or not.

configPath.description:
Directory the `edit` verb writes its scratch copy of a value into, before and
after editing. Created at shell startup; resolved against the project root, so
the file — which holds real etcd contents — lands inside the checkout.

clusters.description:
Clusters this command can reach. Only clusters listed here are offered, and
completion additionally requires a matching kubeconfig to exist.

sourcePath.description: Path to the docusaurus site, added into the image at build time

localPort.description: Host port mapped to the container's port 3000

nodeTag.description: Node base image tag to build against

imageTag.description: Tag of the image being built and run

imageName.description: Name of the image being built and run

volumes.description: Additional docker volume mounts, environment variables are expanded

name.description:
Basename of the generated pair, written as `<name>.pem` and
`<name>-key.pem`. Does not need to be one of `names`.

names.description: Hostnames, wildcards, IPs, URLs or emails the certificate is valid for.

certificatePath.description:
Directory the generated certificates and keys are written to, relative to
the project root. Required by `generate` and `create`, which both refuse to
run when it is empty; created on demand if missing.

certificates.description: Certificates generated by `generate`, one mkcert invocation each.

port.description: Local port the tunnel binds on 127.0.0.1

hostname.description: Cloudflare Access hostname the tunnel connects to

kubeconfig.description: 1Password document holding the kubeconfig; $PORT in it is replaced with the port above

clusters.description: Clusters reachable through a cloudflared tunnel, keyed by the name the command accepts

databases.description: Databases reachable through a cloudflared tunnel, keyed by the name the command accepts

port.description: Local port the tunnel binds on 127.0.0.1

hostname.description: Cloudflare Access hostname the tunnel connects to

Config.description: Config is the schema of a `gocontentful.yaml` file discovered in the project, not of a key in the posh config.

spaceId.description: Contentful space id to generate against

cmaKey.description: Contentful management API key, typically a 1Password secret reference

environment.description: Contentful environment; defaults to "master" when empty

contentTypes.description: Content types to generate code for

Config.description: Config maps a config set name to the sesamy YAML files that are merged, in order, to produce the config each command runs with.

theme.description: Theme is the gnat color theme, passed to the CLI via -theme.

configDir.description: ConfigDir specifies the $XDG_CONFIG_HOME where configuration files are stored.

profiles.description: Profiles maps a name to a NATS server profile; names autocomplete in the shell.

url.description: URL is the NATS server URL, passed to the CLI via -url.

description.description: Description is shown in shell autocompletion.

theme.description: Theme is the tempo color theme, passed to the CLI via --theme.

configDir.description: ConfigDir specifies the $XDG_CONFIG_HOME where configuration files are stored.

profiles.description: Profiles maps a name to a Temporal connection profile; names autocomplete in the shell.

url.description: URL is the Temporal server address (host:port), passed to the CLI via --address.

description.description: Description is shown in shell autocompletion.

url.description:
Harbor base URL including scheme, e.g. `https://harbor.example.org`. Passed
to `docker login` as-is; the registry host is derived from it by stripping a
`https://` prefix, so an `http://` URL or a trailing slash is not handled.

authUrl.description:
Login page opened in a browser by `auth`, typically the OIDC entry point
(`<url>/c/oidc/login`). Opened by `docker` too, so the CLI secret can be
copied from the profile page.

project.description:
Harbor project used to build the throwaway image reference the auth check
pulls. Not used by `auth` or `docker`.

sources.description:
SourcesMap maps a source name to a golang-migrate source URL, e.g.
`file://migrations`. The names are the values the `source` argument accepts.

databases.description:
DatabasesMap maps a database name to a golang-migrate database URL, e.g.
`pgx5://user:password@localhost:5432/db?sslmode=disable`. The names are the
values the `database` argument accepts. A value may contain 1Password
secret references, which are resolved at execution time.

path.description: Directory for browser profile dirs (e.g. .posh/browser); created on startup

command.description: Browser binary path; defaults to Chrome on macOS, google-chrome on Linux

profiles.description: Named environments, each with an optional proxy and default URL

app.description: App indicates whether the application mode is enabled for the profile.

url.description: Default URL to open when no URL argument is given

proxy.description: Proxy passed verbatim to Chrome as --proxy-server, e.g. socks5://localhost:1080

name.description: Account identity passed to gcloud as --account

email.description: Email of the account, for reference only

key.description: 1Password document holding the service account key; without it, login falls back to an interactive browser prompt

name.description: Name of the cluster in GKE, which may differ from the key used to select it

project.description: Google cloud project the cluster belongs to

region.description: Google cloud region the cluster runs in

account.description: Account key to authenticate as; passed to gcloud as --account when set

configPath.description: Path used as CLOUDSDK_CONFIG, keeping gcloud state per project; created on startup

accounts.description: Account configurations, keyed by the name given to `gcloud login`

clusters.description: Cluster configurations, keyed by the name given to `gcloud kubeconfig`

Secret.description: Secret addresses a single field of a 1Password item, in the same terms as an `op://` reference: `op://<vault>/<item>/<field>`, resolved against Account.

account.description:
Account is the 1Password account the vault belongs to, as a sign-in
address or account UUID.

vault.description: Vault is the name or UUID of the vault holding the item.

item.description: Item is the name or UUID of the item within the vault.

field.description: Field is the name of the field to read from the item, e.g. `password`.

Config.description: Config maps an environment name to the Grafana server, org and credentials gcx is run against.

env.description: Env to pass to the cli

tokenCmd.description: TokenCmd to execute returning the token

path.description:
Directory holding the `*.k6.js` scenario scripts and their `*.secret.tpl`
templates. Created at shell startup if missing, and the root the `scenario`
argument is resolved against.

envs.description:
Environments selectable as the first argument, keyed by the name offered in
completion. Each entry's keys are upper-cased and passed to k6 as environment
variables, so they are visible to the scenario via `__ENV`.

path.description:
Directory holding the teleport session state, exported as TELEPORT_HOME
when the provider is constructed. Relative to the project root.

labels.description:
Labels every cluster, app and database must carry to be listed. Combined
into a single tsh --query expression with &&; omit to list everything.

hostname.description: Teleport proxy to authenticate against, e.g. "teleport.example.com:443".

apps.description:
Extra arguments passed to `tsh apps login`, keyed by app name. Prepended
before the app name itself; apps not listed here still work.

user.description:
Database user to log in as. Overridden by the TELEPORT_DATABASE_USER
environment variable when it is set.

aliases.description:
Display names for kube clusters, keyed by the real teleport cluster name.
Completion offers the alias and it is mapped back before login, so the
values must be unique and must not collide with a real cluster name.

path.description:
Root of the terragrunt tree. Environments, sites and stacks are all
discovered beneath it as `<path>/envs/<env>/<site>/<stack>/terragrunt.hcl`,
so this single value determines the whole command surface; nothing else is
configured.

cachePath.description:
Directory terragrunt downloads remote modules into, exported as
`TERRAGRUNT_DOWNLOAD` at shell startup. Resolved against the project root, so
leaving it unset points the download cache at the checkout itself.

path.description:
Directory the cdktf app lives in; every verb runs with this as its working
directory. Also the root walked for `*.stack.yaml` files to discover stack
names.

outPath.description:
Directory cdktf synthesizes into. Used only by `unlock`, which runs
terraform in `<outPath>/stacks/<stack>`, so leaving it unset breaks that
verb while every other one still works.

resourceGroupName.description: Resource group containing the storage account

path.description:
Directory holding one subdirectory per workspace. Workspace names are
discovered from it rather than configured: any child directory containing
`.tf` files and not prefixed with `.` or `_` becomes a valid `workspace`
argument, whether or not it appears under `subscriptions`.

tenantId.description: Azure tenant ID — sets ARM_TENANT_ID for all workspaces; required for CLI auth via az login --allow-no-subscriptions

subscriptions.description:
Per-workspace Azure subscription and backend settings, keyed by workspace
directory name. Optional: a workspace with no entry still runs, but gets no
`ARM_SUBSCRIPTION_ID` and no `-backend-config` flags on `init`.

servicePrincipals.description:
Service principals selectable with `--service-principal`, keyed by the name
offered in completion. Selecting one overrides the default Azure auth chain
for that invocation, including the subscription.

clientSecret.description:
Application client secret, in plaintext. Held in the project config and
exported as ARM_CLIENT_SECRET, so keep it out of version control.

proxy.description:
Named SSH proxy for this workspace. Unused — nothing in this provider reads
it, so setting it has no effect.

templatePath.description: Directory holding the template directories; its parent becomes HYGEN_TMPLS

charts.description: Helm charts installable with the install/uninstall verbs.

registry.description:
Container registry shared by every cluster below. Created on the first
`up` and deleted by any `down`, including while other clusters use it.

clusters.description: Clusters that can be created, keyed by the name used as the argument.

path.description:
Directory holding one subdirectory per chart, relative to the project
root. Its subdirectory names are what the chart argument completes to.

prefix.description:
Prefix prepended to the chart name to form the target namespace, so
chart "base" with prefix "shared-" installs into "shared-base".

enableTraefikRouter.description: EnableTraefikRouter allows to create the cluster with the default traefik router

name.description:
Registry name passed to k3d, which prefixes it with "k3d-" for the
actual container and hostname.

port.description: Host port the registry binds to.

account.description:
Account this provider signs in to and resolves every secret against, as a
sign-in subdomain or account UUID. `register` appends `.1password.eu` to it,
so that verb assumes an EU-hosted account.

tokenFilename.description:
Optional file the session token is written to and reloaded from, so a session
survives restarting the shell. Written mode 0600 and holding a live
credential, so keep it out of version control; leave unset to keep the
session in the process environment only.

logPath.description: Directory license_finder writes its log to, passed as `--log-directory`.

decisionsPath.description:
File recording the approval decisions, passed as `--decisions-file`. Every
`add`/`remove` verb rewrites this file, so it is the provider's only
persistent state and belongs in version control.

written verbatim to Path by `rclone init`. Values may contain 1Password
secret references (op://vault/item/field), which are resolved by piping
the template through `op inject`.

tempDir.description: Directory passed to sqlc as SQLCTMPDIR, resolved relative to the project root

cacheDir.description: Directory passed to sqlc as SQLCCACHE, resolved relative to the project root

name.description:
Real SKE cluster name, passed to the CLI as the positional argument. The
kubeconfig filename comes from the map key instead, unless
`CommandWithClusterNameFn` overrides it.

projects.description:
STACKIT projects addressable by this command, keyed by the name accepted as
the `project` argument. The key is a local alias and need not match the
project's name in STACKIT.

id.description: STACKIT project UUID, passed to the CLI as `--project-id`.

clusters.description:
SKE clusters in this project, keyed by the name accepted as the `cluster`
argument. The key is a local alias; `name` holds the real cluster name.

path.description: Path to the Bruno collection; environment variables are expanded

dirs.description:
Unused. Test directories are discovered by walking for wdio.conf.ts,
never read from here.

modes.description:
Run modes, keyed by name and suggested as the first argument. The key
"browserstack" additionally selects the BrowserStack backend.

sites.description: Sites to test, keyed by name and suggested as the second argument.

secrets.description:
Unused. Declared but read by nothing; only Sites[..].Auth and
BrowserStack resolve secrets.

browserStack.description:
1Password item holding the BrowserStack credentials, read from its
"username" and "password" fields. Required when the "browserstack"
mode is used without --ci; the command panics if it is unset.

auth.description:
1Password item holding basic auth credentials for this environment,
read from its "username" and "password" fields. Omit for no basic auth.

domain.description:
Base domain for this environment, e.g. "staging.example.com". The mode's
host prefix and port are applied on top of it.

port.description: Port appended to the site domain, e.g. "8443". Omit for the default port.

hostPrefix.description: Subdomain prepended to the site domain, e.g. "local". Omit for none.
